method: Each PNG opened and visually reviewed; title, axis labels, counts, footnotes, legends and full negative-value grid inspected. After changing group wording to 历史 Q 阈值对照 and switching to compact font subset, final Q heatmap reopened. All PNGs decoded/verified and SVGs parsed after final export.
corrections: Changed 连续 Q 二分对照 to 历史 Q 阈值对照 to avoid confusing median-split classes with a continuous-feature model.
Used official Noto CJK font, embedded SVG paths, and a 169212-byte font subset for reproducible Chinese labels.
publication_limits: Heatmaps should occupy a full page / supplement. Differences use different feasible image supports, not shared-domain ranking. ALL classification figure is descriptive only.
